pages.text: Right-click the altar to open it. Put the item (or a book) in the top slot and the offering below, with at least $(l)2 soul flames$() nearby (soul fire, torches, lanterns or campfires), then press $(l)Infuse$(). The screen tells you what is missing. Each level costs 5 experience levels.$(br)$(li)2 $(item)Magma Shells$(): $(l)Ember Stride$() (boots).$(li)4 $(item)Soul Dust$(): $(l)Soul Harvest$() (weapons).$(li)2 $(item)Basalt Carapaces$(): $(l)Anchoring$() (chest, legs).
